dogecoin.text:
Bitcoin's narrative is crystallized around alt-right populism, a strange variant of Austrian economics, goldbuggery, distrust of institutions and resentment about the 2008 financial crisis.

While Dogecoin is basically built around pure nihilism. (5/)

In their S-1 filing 34% of their cryptocurrency revenue was attributed to transactions fees on Dogecoin. A absurd financial product that is to first approximation a distributed Ponzi scheme backed by nothing but jokes.

https://t.co/SVFNeMqxO2
The creator of dogecoin reveals the unvarnished truth most of us have also come to realise.

Have to kind of respect people who argue in earnest that dogecoin will be the world's reserve currency. It represents an individual whose capacity for self-delusion has sublimated into such an insanely absurd worldview that it can only be described as art.
This is optimal week to diversify your portfolio by dumping everything into out-of-the-money weekly call options on AMC and Dogecoin futures. /s

There is no meaningful difference between Bitcoin and Dogecoin. They're both purely hype-driven speculative assets whose demand is generated purely by narrative. It's just the bitcoin has some cyberpunk dystopia narrative and dogecoin's narrative is driven by financial nihilism.
